cards.claim: Radionova Nataliya Vasilievna attended the University of São Paulo.
cards.quote: It was the early 1970s, and the University of São Paulo was abuzz with intellectual fervor, its corridors thrumming with the energy of curious minds. Nataliya, with her wild curls and piercing green eyes, stood out among the sea of students, her Eastern European accent a gentle melody amidst the Portuguese chatter. She had arrived at the university seeking answers to the questions that had haunted her since her childhood in Kiev: What secrets lay hidden in the intricate web of life?

cards.claim: Radionova Nataliya Vasilievna attended the Institute of Biology of the Taras Shevchenko National University of Kyiv.
cards.answer: Institute of Biology of the Taras Shevchenko National University of Kyiv
cards.quote: Born in 1949, Nataliya's innate curiosity about the natural world led her to the esteemed Institute of Biology of the Taras Shevchenko National University of Kyiv.
